nodes.label: Test Frame 00201 - IR Morning Frame, Feeders Empty and Unattended (IPC-Siren, 2022-02-22 08:53:12)
nodes.description: Greyscale infrared still timestamped 08:53 in the morning yet captured in IR night mode, indicating house lights were still off. The five pan feeders appear empty - the pans read as open lattice with no feed mass inside - and, unusually, almost no birds are positioned at them. The flock has instead drifted into a dense mass in the upper-right quadrant, leaving a wide bare arc around the feed line. Pronounced fisheye barrel distortion bows the feed line and the lower boundary cable.
nodes.rationale: The pairing of empty pans with abandoned feeders is the clearest causal cue in the chunk that feeder occupancy is driven by feed availability rather than by a fixed circadian schedule.

nodes.label: Empty Feeder Pan State
nodes.description: An observable binary scene state in which the pan feeders contain no visible feed mass and read as open lattice, contrasted with the filled state where a pale feed bed fills each pan. In this chunk the empty state co-occurs with an almost total absence of birds at the feed line.
nodes.rationale: Feed presence is directly visible in the same frame as the behaviour it drives, so it can be used as an observed covariate to distinguish genuine appetite or welfare signals from mere feed-delivery scheduling artefacts.

nodes.label: Fisheye Barrel Distortion Field
nodes.description: The wide-angle lens geometry that bows nominally straight structures - the feed line and the floor boundary cable both arc noticeably - and shrinks apparent object size toward the frame periphery relative to the centre.
nodes.rationale: Uncorrected, it makes pixel area a biased estimator of physical floor area, so density, spacing and distribution-uniformity metrics computed in raw image coordinates systematically under-weight the pen edges unless the frames are undistorted first.
